aircraft._commentFlaps: No aircraft-specific flap detents are configured; use physical flap angle or raw handle percent pending in-sim handle-index verification.

aircraftCfg._comment: Use aircraft.cfg as high-confidence fallback only when the B38M type designator is paired with Microsoft/Asobo creator evidence.

lvars._comment: The cited Microsoft and Asobo sources do not define a 737 MAX 8 external LVAR, B-var, input-event, or hardware-integration map. Active telemetry stays on standard SimConnect data.

controls._comment: Only standard gear/flaps surface fallback is allowed. Boeing-specific autopilot, MCP, autothrottle, spoiler, and lighting writes remain unavailable until exact variables/events are verified.

meta.notes: Dedicated monitoring-first page and identity profile for the included MSFS 2024 Boeing 737 MAX 8. The trusted Microsoft/Asobo adapter exposes an explicit standard-SimVar monitoring surface while aircraft-specific telemetry and cockpit writes remain inactive pending vendor documentation and in-sim verification.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 FAQ - aircraft matrix
sources.notes: Lists the Boeing 737 Max 8 under manufacturer Boeing and confirms it is included with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Standard, Deluxe, Premium Deluxe, and Aviator editions.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Sim Update 2 release notes
sources.notes: Uses the official Boeing 737 MAX 8 product heading and documented package identifiers; it does not define an external custom-variable contract.

sources.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator - Aircraft Manuals
sources.notes: The official manuals page does not list a 737 MAX 8 manual or external telemetry/control interface.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 Avionics Framework - SimVars
sources.notes: Documents standard MSFS SimVars/A-vars as queryable simulator state. The trusted monitoring adapter uses an explicit standard-SimVar allowlist and activates no aircraft-specific L: or B: variables.

sources.name: MSFS 2024 Avionics Framework - Key Events
sources.notes: Documents key events as simulator control bindings. This profile does not add custom key-event mappings; it only permits Flight Fabric's narrow standard gear/flaps fallback.

knownIssues: Exact MSFS 2024 737 MAX 8 TITLE strings remain unverified in-sim.
